actions.description:
Trigger A creature leaves the swarm's space

Effect The swarm takes [[/r {1d6}]]{1d6 damage} as ticks cling to the creature and continue biting, dealing @Damage[3d6[bleed]]. Immersion in water reduces the DC of the flat check to end this persistent damage to 5, and any area damage dealt to the creature destroys these clinging ticks.
actions.name: Cling
actions.trigger: A creature leaves the swarm's space

actions.description: Each enemy in the swarm's space takes @Damage[3d6[piercing]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:28|basic] save) plus Cling and exposure to tick fever.
actions.name: Swarming Bites

actions.description: This monster doesn't have a single mind (typically because it's a swarm of smaller creatures), and is immune to mental effects that target only a specific number of creatures. It is still subject to mental effects that affect all creatures in an area.
actions.name: Swarm Mind

actions.description:
Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:27]

Onset 1 day

Stage 1 Enfeebled 1 (1 day)

Stage 2 Enfeebled 2 (1 day).
actions.name: Tick Fever

name: Tick Swarm
publicNotes: This swarm of thousands of fist-sized ticks forms a moving carpet of bloated insects-a nauseating and intimidating sight.
